svg.title: Object Model — EBSD
svg.desc: UML-style object model of pytex.ebsd: the crystal map and its phases, grain segmentation and the grain graph, boundary networks, and the workflow object that turns a normalized map into texture outputs.
svg.text: Crystal maps, grain segmentation, boundary networks, and the texture workflow
composition - a required field: the owner cannot exist without it
association - an optional or defaulted field
* after a field name: the field holds a sequence
ProvenanceRecord is omitted: 102 classes carry it, on every result object.
Fields naming another card are listed first; the rest are summarized.
